summary: If all encrypted content uses one password, use --ask-vault-pass to be prompted or --vault-password-file pointing to a password file or client script.
questions: How do I get prompted for the vault password?
How do I use a vault password file with ansible-playbook?

answer_card.title: Passing a single vault password
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-playbook --ask-vault-pass site.yml
ansible-playbook --vault-password-file /path/to/my/vault-password-file site.yml
ansible-playbook --vault-password-file my-vault-password-client.py
```
